newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Debt Office lowers '96 PSBR forecast.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Debt Office lowers '96 PSBR forecast.

text.p: The Swedish National Debt Office said on Wednesday it had lowered its state borrowing forecast for the current year to between 20 and 30 billion crowns from its previous forecast of 40 to 50 billion.

"The main reason for the gradual reduction of the forecast is strengthening in state revenue. A share buy back of (state-controlled) Nordbanken and reduced net lending has produced the latest reduction," the debt office said.
The office said demand for index-linked bonds has surpassed expectations. So far this year sales have totalled 42 billion crowns.
